name: dn-intermediate-narrows-permitted-valid
description: RFC 5280 §6.1.4(g)(1): when two CAs both restrict directoryName, the intersection is the narrower subtree. The root permits O=NC Tests,C=US; the intermediate further narrows to O=NC Tests,OU=Subsidiary,C=US. The leaf subject O=NC Tests,OU=Subsidiary,CN=...,C=US is in the intersection and the chain must validate.
notes: Companion to multi-ca-widening-attempt-invalid (DNS) but for directoryName. Many implementations only intersect DNS/IP NCs - directoryName intersection across multiple CAs in the chain is a less-tested code path.
